can.name: Watering Can
can.desc: Holds 20 waterings. Fill it at the well or a rain barrel.

hoe2.name: Steel Hoe
hoe2.desc: Salvaged steel. Turns three tiles in a row.

can2.name: Big Can
can2.desc: Holds 40 waterings and soaks three tiles in a row.

pick.name: Pick
pick.desc: Breaks rock and pries scrap loose.

machete.name: Machete
machete.desc: Cuts through scrub and anything that comes at night.

pistol.name: Service Pistol
pistol.desc: Meridian issue. Loud. Every shot is heard across the valley.

sunflower_seed.name: Sunflower Seed
sunflower_seed.desc: Pulls poison out of the ground. Harvest it and the soil around it is cleaner.

wood.name: Wood
wood.desc: Dead timber. The valley has a lot of it.

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.desc: Metal from before. Worth more to the Hull than it looks.

compost.name: Compost
compost.desc: Spread on tilled soil to make it richer. Use it on a tilled tile.

tinned_beans.name: Tinned Beans
tinned_beans.desc: Old stock from the Hull. The label is a guess.

flatbread.name: Flatbread
flatbread.desc: Ash-grey flour, but it fills you.

iodide_tabs.name: Iodide Tabs
iodide_tabs.desc: Lowers the dose you have taken on. Take them after a day in bad ground.

fence.name: Fence
fence.desc: Keeps slow things out of the field. Husks will batter through in time.

gate.name: Gate
gate.desc: You and your people can pass. Husks cannot.

lamp.name: Lamp Post
lamp.desc: Lights the ground at night. Husks come to light.

compost_bin.name: Compost Bin
compost_bin.desc: Put crop waste and fibre in. Compost comes out two days later.

bunk.name: Bunk
bunk.desc: A bed for one hired hand.

rain_barrel.name: Rain Barrel
rain_barrel.desc: Fills when it rains. Refill the can here.

spike_trap.name: Spike Trap
spike_trap.desc: Hurts what walks over it. Not you.

sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
sprinkler.desc: Waters the four tiles beside it every morning.

roast_potato.name: Roast Potato
roast_potato.desc: Black on the outside. Good on the inside.

corn_cakes.name: Corn Cakes
corn_cakes.desc: Fried flat on a hot stone.

field_stew.name: Field Stew
field_stew.desc: Whatever came out of the ground today, in one pot.

pumpkin_mash.name: Pumpkin Mash
pumpkin_mash.desc: Sweet enough to feel like a holiday.

hen.name: Hen
hen.desc: Scrawny, loud, and worth it. Let her out near a coop. She forages by day and lays if she has eaten.

coop.name: Coop
coop.desc: Holds four hens. They shut themselves in at dusk.
